name: 🔪 MAFIA [V2.2.1]
desc:
CHAPTER 2: TAR AND ASH, IS OUT NOW!

Somebody at this table is a killer. Good luck figuring out who.

MAFIA is a social deduction game remade around the classic Mafia formula — but when night strikes, the kills happen in first person. Watch the Mafia hunt their target, the Doctor scramble to save them, and the town erupt into chaos when the lights come back on.

Sit at the table. Read the room. Cast your vote. Get it wrong, and the Mafia wins.
16 roles. Multiple maps. No one you can trust.

🔔 Join the group for updates and events!
⚠️ Data doesn't save in private servers!
